pipelines.name: mymo_register_data_collection
pipelines.description: Daily (T-1) batch pipeline collecting 2 files from MyMo Vipera via FTP (ftp-mymo): mymo_register (all MyMo registration activity) and mymo_changemode (MyMo mode-change activity, e.g. Normal <-> SecurePlus). Stores raw copies to the HDFS raw zone (vipera-sourced path), then loads into Hive (prod_safe_mymo.register, prod_safe_mymo.change_mode). Business purpose: store data related to MyMo registration and mode changes for further calculations. ~10,000 records/day. Severity level 3 pipeline; monitored via Slack notification on job success/failure.
